# ContextSutra AI

> Local-first, keyless, offline CLI (npm: contextsutra) that scans a code repository into a verifiable, privacy-aware "context capsule", detects when that context is stale, and ships 12 portable Agent Skills for Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot. Zero runtime dependencies. Apache-2.0. Created by Vatsal Shah.

## What it does
- scan: bounded, read-only inventory of docs, ADRs, tasks and manifest metadata with SHA-256 per source
- review: privacy gate (BLOCK or HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED); never certifies safe
- verify / diff: freshness and drift detection against the live repository
- render / report: host-ready Markdown and a human Markdown + HTML report
- audit: self-audit with 47 checks, written as JSON, Markdown and HTML
- install / doctor: copy skills to host directories; report presence and drift, never activation

## What it does not do
No model inference, no network calls, no telemetry, no API key, no reading of IDE chat history, no digital signatures, no compliance certification. Redaction is regex best effort.
